body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Madrid, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 – 2.5 hours, over a route of about 3 km. It starts at Calle de Bailén, Pl. de la Armería, 2. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Royal Palace of Madrid. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Ekaterina as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> There is no way you can miss this great opportunity to enter and explore one of the few European palaces, official residences of Heads of State open to the public, at your own pace!
>
> Take this in-app audio tour with an entrance ticket included, to immerse yourself in the unique royal atmosphere of Spanish Court life and enjoy the exquisiteness of its decoration.
>
> Step on the rooms visited by 2 million people annually but at the same time so restricted when it comes to official events presided over by the current kings of Spain, His Majesty King Philip VI and Her Majesty Queen Letizia.
>
> Discover the past of one of the most important sites in Spanish history where each square meter keeps memories of the powerful of the Spanish monarchy and the geniuses in charge of recreating environments of the finest beauty around them.
>
> Let's enjoy awesome views of Madrid over two royal gardens: Campo del Moro, Sabatini Gardens, and the largest green area in Madrid, Casa de Campo.
>
> You will take a walk to the Royal Garden, Campo del Moro, learn about its history and landmarks, and, at the end of the visit, have a chance to rest and enjoy a drink in the park's restaurant service.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.46. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 298 ratings and 91 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
